events.title: Demo v0.6.486 — Sopwith Camel handling update
events.summary: Thanks to your feedback, the Camel now handles differently through left and right hard turns: Right hard turns retain Cruise energy. Left hard turns reduce Cruise to Slow. The maneuver preview explains the effect before you commit. The update is live now. Thank you for playing and helping us improve the demo during Next Fest.

events.title: Dev Update #6: Clearer Orders, Better Reports
events.summary: Hello, pilots! Recent playtests took Rotary Knights down different paths: shadowing a contact instead of engaging, leaving an objective unfinished, splitting a bomb load across passes, and switching careers after combat. Those choices exposed places where the game needed to explain its results more clearly. This update focuses on the journey from orders to the squadron's return report. events.title: Dev Update #5: The First Hour, Rebuilt
events.summary: Hello, pilots! A new Rotary Knights career in development begins in General Service. You arrive without a specialization, learn the common work of an RFC pilot, and fly an Avro 504 familiarization circuit before choosing the posting that will shape your career. That order matters. It lets the first decision come from something you have done in the cockpit instead of a label on a character-creation screen. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45997825/6f3c8d11e9532e8a5c088d89c0c63a7286eab078.png Earn Your Posting
